2. Clean data and calculate entrapment efficiency (%)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Make sure variables are numeric / factors as needed
dat_clean <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Time.infection.hr = as.numeric(Time.infection.hr),
    Rep = as.factor(Rep),
    MOI = as.factor(MOI),
    spores.ml = as.numeric(spores.ml),
    virospores.ml = as.numeric(virospores.ml),
    
    entrapment.efficiency = virospores.ml / (virospores.ml + spores.ml),
    entrapment.percent = entrapment.efficiency * 100
  )
```

3. Convert to long format
```{r}
spore_viro_long <- dat_clean %>%
  select(Sample.ID, Time.infection.hr, Rep, MOI, spores.ml, virospores.ml) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(spores.ml, virospores.ml),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "count.ml"
  )
# Initial plot
ggplot(spore_viro_long,
       aes(x = Time.infection.hr,
           y = count.ml,
           color = type,
           group = interaction(type, MOI))) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ MOI) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Time of infection (h)",
    y = "Count per mL",
    color = NULL
  ) 
```

4. Plotting entrapment efficiency
```{r}
ggplot(dat_clean,
       aes(x = Time.infection.hr,
           y = entrapment.percent,
           color = MOI,
           group = MOI)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Time of infection (h)",
    y = "Entrapment efficiency (%)",
    color = "MOI"
  )
```

7. Plot MOI = 1; parse data and then plot
```{r}
moi1 <- dat_clean %>% filter(MOI == "1")

moi1_long <- moi1 %>%
  select(Time.infection.hr, spores.ml, virospores.ml) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(spores.ml, virospores.ml),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "count.ml"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type = factor(
      type,
      levels = c("spores.ml", "virospores.ml"),
      labels = c("Spores", "Virospores")
    )
  )
ggplot(moi1_long,
       aes(x = Time.infection.hr,
           y = count.ml,
           color = type,
           group = type)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se,
               geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.3) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Time of infection (h)",
    y = "Cells per mL",
    color = NULL
  ) 
```

9. Trying out stats 
```{r}
# Linear model 1
lm1 <- lm(entrapment.percent ~ factor(Time.infection.hr), data = dat_clean)
anova(lm1) #anova on model 1
# Linear model 2
model2 <- lm(
  entrapment.percent ~ factor(Time.infection.hr) * factor(MOI),
  data = dat_clean
)
model2

anova(model2) # anova on model 2
library(emmeans)

emmeans(model2, pairwise ~ Time.infection.hr,
        adjust = "tukey")

GLM
```{r}
glm1 <- glm(
  entrapment.efficiency ~ factor(Time.infection.hr),
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = dat_clean
)
anova(glm1, test = "F")
```
